name: share_of_voice
description: Share of voice from raw mention results. Deterministic — the number on the invoice. Probes that never reached a surface are excluded from the denominator and reported separately.

reached.description: Did this probe get a real answer. FALSE for a captcha, login wall or consent gate. A false is EXCLUDED from the percentage: an empty citation list from a blocked probe is not evidence that the assistant failed to mention the client. Absent means reached, so rows written before this field existed keep counting.

surface.description: Which assistant answered, for the blocked-by breakdown.

blocked_by.description: When `reached` is false, what stopped it, in one line.

share_of_voice_pct.description: Null when nothing was reached. Zero per cent is a finding; no measurement is not.

queries.description: Probes that RETURNED AN ANSWER. The denominator.

unreached.description: Probes that never got an answer. Never folded into the percentage.

blocked_by.description: Surface and reason for each refusal, with counts.
